whatChanged: NEW: CRH completes its ~$8.5bn all-cash acquisition of Arcosa at $150 a share, its largest deal ever, closing well ahead of the original Q1 2027 timetable (crh-arcosa-acquisition)
NEW: UDR forms a $2.0bn multifamily joint venture with Apollo, which puts in $1.34bn of equity for a two-thirds stake in 19 communities; closing expected 29 October (udr-apollo-multifamily-jv)

ADVANCED: LSEG signs a definitive $3.535bn all-cash deal to buy credit-data firm Octus from Permira, its biggest acquisition since Refinitiv; completion expected H1 2027 (lseg-octus-acquisition) (rumored → confirmed)

ADVANCED: BASF reportedly raises its Evonik offer to €24 a share, valuing Evonik at about €11.2bn, after pledging job protections to 2032; Evonik and RAG-Stiftung decline to comment (evk-basf-acquisition) (rumored → rumored)

ADVANCED: AkzoNobel and Axalta formally offer EU remedies, including the sale of AkzoNobel's European refinish business, extending the Commission's deadline into November (akza-axalta-merger) (confirmed → confirmed)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep taking listed businesses off public markets. EQT signed a board-recommended €46.50-a-share cash offer for Qiagen on 21 October, about €10.8bn EV (qgen-eqt-take-private), and EQT Infrastructure signed a A$3.095-a-share cash scheme for Cleanaway on 19 October (cwy-eqt-infrastructure-take-private). Penske Corporation and Mitsui will pay $212 a share for the Penske Automotive float (pag-penske-mitsui-take-private), a GTCR-led consortium with Elliott will pay $7.75 a share for CCC Intelligent Solutions (cccs-gtcr-elliott-take-private), and Thoma Bravo's Proofpoint will pay $49.75 a share for Varonis (vrns-proofpoint-acquisition). Ithaca Holdings is taking Bumble private (bmbl-ithaca-take-private), CD&R and McKesson are buying Option Care Health (opch-cdr-mckesson-take-private), and Viatris is tendering for Pacira (pcrx-viatris-acquisition). EP Group's Fnac Darty tender has its EU clearance (fnac-ep-group-takeover-bid), while Aurora's board has again rejected Curaleaf's hostile bid, which runs to 4 December (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid). Cencora is buying out the listed American Oncology Network at a $2.4bn EV (cor-aon-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals keep being decided by regulators, politicians and courts rather than the parties. Paramount's ~$110bn Warner Bros. Discovery takeover closed only after a 12-state antitrust settlement (psky-wbd-acquisition). Kimberly-Clark has cleared China's in-depth SAMR review for Kenvue, after paying for EU and Australian clearance with feminine-care divestments (kmb-kenvue-acquisition). AkzoNobel and Axalta have formally offered EU remedies, with AkzoNobel selling its European refinish business and the Commission's deadline pushed into November (akza-axalta-merger). BT's rescue of TalkTalk waits on a ministerial public-interest decision after the CMA's 19 October report (bt-talktalk-acquisition). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to control Commerzbank, but Berlin's opposition remains (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Brazil's CADE cleared Transocean-Valaris without conditions (val-transocean-acquisition).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks on surplus cash
themes.note: Large-caps with surplus capital keep expanding share repurchases, each tying the bigger programme to a specific capital tailwind. GM authorized a new $20bn buyback with its Q3 results after finishing its $6bn programme (gm-buyback-2026), and TD has OSFI approval to buy back up to another C$10bn (td-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large banks and industrials are bidding for rivals to get the scale to compete with US and Chinese peers, with controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors deciding outcomes. BASF has reportedly lifted its Evonik offer to €24 a share (about €11.2bn) and pledged to honour Evonik's job and site agreements through 2032, with RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake decisive (evk-basf-acquisition). The ECB has cleared UniCredit to move past 30% of Commerzbank despite Berlin's opposition (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Intesa Sanpaolo has sweetened its Monte dei Paschi offer and won Delfin's backing, but the MPS board still calls it too low ahead of the 29 October vote (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Apollo is among the bidders for Uniper (un01-apollo-acquisition).

themes.label: Governments selling state-held stakes to strategic and financial buyers
themes.note: Several governments are privatising long-held stakes and choosing buyers on price plus industrial plan. India's cabinet approved selling 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax (ffh-idbi-bank-acquisition). Portugal picked Lufthansa's all-cash offer for 44.9% of TAP Air Portugal while keeping a 50.1% majority (lha-tap-stake-acquisition). Germany is selling up to 74.12% of Uniper to meet EU rules, drawing a non-binding Apollo bid among several (un01-apollo-acquisition).
